name: ParkingPermitManager
tagline: Parking permits, bays, waitlist and renewals – one plug-and-play Power Apps component.
description: A complete parking permit app for residential towers, office buildings and mixed-use car parks. Configure zones and bays in one line, keep the permit register, allocate bays on an interactive bay map, run a fair waitlist with time-limited offers, renew permits and track payments, and check plates on a phone. Works with any canvas data source, model-driven views and the Power Pages Web API, with demo data out of the box.
features: Zones and bays with monthly fees from a single low-code setting
Interactive bay map with keyboard navigation and one-click allocation
Waitlist ordered by accessible need, priority points and application date
Time-limited bay offers with lapsed-offer alerts
Status workflow with business rules, bulk changes with skipped-permit list and undo
Renewals, payment tracking and monthly revenue KPI
Plate check for patrols with zone context
Plate format validation (any, Singapore, UK, US, Australia) and duplicate detection
Per-unit permit limits and oversell for unreserved permits
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
